messages:
emma-cs: hey team, onboarding check-in for OrbitHealth — they keep hitting sporadic 429s during initial SDK ramp. customer sees bursts when spinning up workers. logs attached below.

tara-orbithealth: yeah, we spin 200 short-lived workers for preflight + embed warmups. starts fine then lots of 429s ~3m in. no code change, just traffic ramp.

emma-cs: capturing logs from their edge:
```
[2026-03-19T18:12:01Z] POST /v1/preflight 200 - token_lease=ok
[2026-03-19T18:12:01Z] POST /v1/embeds 429 - rate_limit: preflight_quota_exhausted
[2026-03-19T18:12:02Z] POST /v1/preflight 429 - token_lease_wait
[2026-03-19T18:12:03Z] POST /v1/embeds 429 - retry_after: 2
```

sam-devex: quick thought — are they re-creating SDK clients per worker? that can cause TLS/HTTP2 handshakes that break connection reuse and cause preflight fanout.

tara-orbithealth: we instantiate new client per job (short-lived process). switching to pooled clients is on roadmap but customer can't refactor quickly. any mitigations?

rafael-infra: two angles: 1) token-lease contention: ephemeral tokens are issued with a limited concurrent-lease budget per API key. 2) preflight counting: each new connection triggers preflight checks. short-lived clients amplify both.

sam-devex: mitigation options we can propose without code rewrite:
- enable client-side connection reuse via simple env var in SDK (if possible)
- add splay + jitter to worker start times to avoid thundering herd
- ask OrbitHealth to switch to token refresh endpoint that supports lease multiplexing (see snippet)

emma-cs: can we provide a drop-in config snippet they can set in their process envs? they'd prefer not to change app code.

sam-devex: yep. JS example (env flags we support):
```
REDWOOD_SDK_KEEP_ALIVE=true
REDWOOD_SDK_MAX_CONCURRENT_PRELIGHT=10
REDWOOD_SDK_PRELIGHT_SPLAY_MS=250
REDWOOD_SDK_EPHEMERAL_LEASE_MODE=multiplex
```

sam-devex: Python equivalent via envs is the same; SDK reads them on import time.

rafael-infra: also adding server-side quick fix — temporary lease relaxation for this account while they ramp. Tara, do you want us to open a short-lived quota bump?

tara-orbithealth: yes please, that would unblock us for today. we need a 3x preflight window for next 4 hours while we roll.

emma-cs: noted — opening quota request and scheduling a coordination call in 20. @rafael-infra can you run the policy change and post the audit id here?

rafael-infra: policy change applied, audit id: audit_20260319_049. I also set a temporary circuit-breaker rule to fallback to lower-rate-models to reduce token churn. watch for >5xx spikes.

token-bot: Token system note: ephemeral_lease_count for key orbit_key_47 increased from 20 -> 60 until 2026-03-19T22:15:00Z.

tara-orbithealth: after the env flags and bumped lease we saw immediate improvement, 429s dropped to <0.5% and warmup completed. thanks!

emma-cs: great — next steps for OrbitHealth:
1) implement simple client pooling (we'll share a 10-line helper)
2) keep preflight_splay enabled for at least first 24h of ramp
3) we'll remove quota bump after 4h and monitor

sam-devex: i'll DM the 10-line pooling helper + a tiny nginx sidecar suggestion they can drop into their runner image if they can't change code quickly.

emma-cs: closing this thread for now — will reopen if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
